description: A reversible change shipped without a down migration must be flagged for missing rollback
input:
Review this migration. There is an up migration but no down migration provided:
```sql
-- up.sql
ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN nickname VARCHAR(64);
```
No down.sql exists in the change.
rubric: PASS only if the review notes the absence of a down/rollback migration and recommends adding one (the change is trivially reversible, so it should say so). It must not incorrectly claim the change is irreversible.
